info.description: An experimental research gateway and protocol bridge connecting OpenAI and Anthropic client applications to Google Antigravity CLI via standard Agent Client Protocol (ACP).
info.title: agy-gateway API

get.description: Lists all Google Antigravity credential accounts managed by the gateway, including IDs, aliases, emails, subscription tiers, health statuses, and cooldown timestamps.

401.description: Unauthorized: missing or invalid Admin Bearer token

403.description: Forbidden: Admin API key is not configured

post.description: Submits the Google authorization code or full loopback redirect URL captured from the administrator's browser to finalize token exchange and store credentials in the central vault.

parameters.description: Login ID and either authorization code or full loopback redirect URL
parameters.name: request

200.description: OAuth token exchange completed and account synced

400.description: Invalid payload, invalid redirect URL, or token exchange failure

401.description: Unauthorized: missing or invalid Admin Bearer token

403.description: Forbidden: Admin API key is not configured

get.description: Returns the service liveness state. Used by orchestrators (Kubernetes, Docker) to determine if process is alive.
Exposes real-time Prometheus metrics for telemetry, request tracking, error counts, and worker pool utilization.
Returns readiness state indicating worker pool availability and gateway capability to process requests.

200.description: Service is ready to handle traffic

post.description: Creates a model response for the given chat conversation. 100% compliant with the OpenAI 2026 chat completions standard. Supports streaming SSE (stream: true), multi-turn conversation history, real-time reasoning thoughts (reasoning_effort and reasoning_content), client-side tool calling with JIT prompt envelope translation, and automated multi-account failover.

parameters.description: Chat completion request parameters including model, messages, tools, and reasoning preferences
parameters.name: request

400.description: Invalid JSON body, missing parameters, or unsupported option (e.g. n > 1)

401.description: Missing, expired, or invalid Client Bearer API key

404.description: Requested model identifier was not found in catalog

429.description: Client rate limit exceeded (RPM) or all accounts in cooldown

500.description: Internal gateway error or failure executing turn across workers

post.description: Creates a structured message response for conversational turns. 100% compliant with Anthropic Messages API (2026 standard). Supports streaming SSE (stream: true), multi-turn conversation history, real-time reasoning (extended thinking), client-side tool calling with JIT prompt envelope translation, and automated multi-account failover.

parameters.description: Anthropic Messages request parameters including model, messages, tools, and thinking preferences
parameters.name: request

400.description: Invalid JSON body, missing parameters, or validation violation

401.description: Missing, expired, or invalid API key

404.description: Requested model identifier was not found in catalog

429.description: Client rate limit exceeded (RPM) or all accounts in cooldown

500.description: Internal gateway error or failure executing turn across workers

AdminBearerAuth.description: Admin Control Plane authorization. Format: `Bearer <your-admin-api-key>` or directly `<your-admin-api-key>`. Used to access administrative endpoints (`/admin/v1/*`).
AdminBearerAuth.name: Authorization

ClientBearerAuth.description: Client API authorization. Format: `Bearer <your-client-api-key>` or directly `<your-client-api-key>`. Used to access OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic endpoints (`/v1/*`).
ClientBearerAuth.name: Authorization
